ticks.note: Tick 1 enters `Run`; the self-loops are delayed. `speed` starts at `Speed.OFF`, which the trace shows as 0.
A press: `speed == Speed.OFF` holds, so the first transition sets `speed` to `Speed.LOW`, shown as 1, and `power` to 40.
`button` is still true, so the fan steps again: back to `Speed.OFF`, 0. A held button steps once per tick; to step once per press, react to its [rising edge](/patterns/edges/).
